caption: Per-soldier multi-target melee: a player Infantry regiment fights two distinct adjacent enemy regiments at once. target_enemy_uid locks onto one of them (uid 2) and never rotates, but BOTH enemies take casualties over the same window -- uid 1 drops 26 -> 24, uid 2 drops 22 -> 20 by tick 400 -- because every attacking soldier now finds its own nearest enemy across every adjacent engaged unit, instead of the whole regiment being confined to whichever single enemy target_enemy resolves to (previously #1086's round-robin had to rotate the target over many cadences to reach a second enemy at all).
